content_sections.heading: ESIC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ESIC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ESIC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 43 vacancies are available - 1 for Accident & Emergency Medicine, 1 for Anesthesia, 2 for Anatomy, 2 for Biochemistry, 1 for Chest, 1 for Community Medicine, 1 for Dermatology, 1 for ENT, 3 for Forensic Medicine, 6 for ICU, 5 for Medicine, 2 for Microbiology, 1 for Orthopedics, 2 for Pediatrics, 1 for Pathology, 1 for Pharmacology, 1 for Physiology, 1 for PMR, 2 for Reproductive Medicine & Surgery, 3 for Radiology, and 3 for Surgery.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 69 years as on the date of the interview. The tenure can extend up to a maximum of 70 years. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Based on academic credentials and interview performance.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ESIC Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to report at the venue on 12 August 2026 with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 43 vacancies for Teaching Faculty posts across various departments at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for the Teaching Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Eligibility criteria include MBBS degree, MD/MS/DNB, updated medical registration, and specific course certificates as per the latest NMC guidelines. Experience requirements also apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ESIC Teaching Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 69 years as on the date of the interview, with a maximum tenure up to 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The salary varies by post: Professor (Rs. 2,63,070/-), Associate Professor (Rs. 1,74,936/-), and Assistant Professor (Rs. 1,50,294/-) per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for 'Others' category, while SC/ST/ESIC Employees, Female Candidates, Ex-servicemen, and PwD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for ESIC Teaching Faculty to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad, Haryana, 121001.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on academic credentials and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The recruitment is on a contract basis for the Teaching Faculty positions.
